## Endrick could revive his Real Madrid career during Vinicius’ suspension

Endrick could have a chance to revive his Real Madrid career following Vinicius Junior’s suspension. [...] Related News

 Mourinho talks Guler, Vinicius, Endrick, Valverde, Javier Tebas, January transfer plans ahead of Real Madrid vs Sevilla

 ‘It’s crazy – Real Madrid star defends Vinícius Jr. over 4-match ban [...] The 20-year-old posed a greater threat and offered more defensively than Vinicius. He made three recoveries, one more than his fellow Brazilian, despite playing fewer minutes.

Endrick has endured a difficult start to the season due to injuries. He has played just 35 minutes across all competitions.

The same can be said of his overall spell with the Spanish giants since joining the club in 2024.
